name: Peppol e-Invoicing Integration by SendPol
author: SendPol

sections.description:
SendPol makes life much easier for WooCommerce merchants by automating the connection with the Peppol network.
With this plugin you streamline invoicing workflows: orders are converted into UBL invoices and sent through Peppol automatically, without manual effort.

Key features

  • Deep WooCommerce integration: detect orders and turn them into invoices automatically.
  • Generate UBL (Universal Business Language) invoices compatible with governments and corporate buyers.
  • Deliver each invoice via Peppol for standardized, compliant e-invoicing.
  • Supports external invoice PDFs from popular plugins like PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce and YITH WooCommerce PDF Invoices & Packing Slips.

Supported plugins

  • Custom Order Statuses for WooCommerce: https://wordpress.org/plugins/custom-order-statuses-woocommerce/
  • Advanced Custom Order Status for WooCommerce: https://wordpress.org/plugins/advanced-custom-order-status-for-woocommerce/
  • BP Custom Order Status for WooCommerce: https://wordpress.org/plugins/bp-custom-order-status-for-woocommerce/
  • PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce: https://wordpress.org/plugins/woocommerce-pdf-invoices-packing-slips/
  • YITH Essential Kit for WooCommerce: https://wordpress.org/plugins/yith-essential-kit-for-woocommerce-1/
  • YITH WooCommerce PDF Invoices & Packing Slips Premium: https://yithemes.com/themes/plugins/yith-woocommerce-pdf-invoice/?utm_source=sendpol&utm_medium=yith-woocommerce-pdf-invoice&utm_campaign=sendpol

Why choose SendPol?

From 2026 onward, Peppol e-invoicing becomes mandatory in more European countries, especially for enterprises and public-sector contracts. SendPol keeps you compliant without complex setups or large development costs.

How does it work?

  1. Install and activate the plugin in your WordPress/WooCommerce environment.
  2. Configure your Peppol settings (provide your API key).
  3. Each completed WooCommerce order automatically becomes a UBL invoice.
  4. The invoice is sent through Peppol to the recipient with all required metadata (customer details, VAT number, and more).

Who is this plugin for?

  • Stores that invoice businesses and/or governments.
  • Companies in countries where Peppol is increasingly required or widely adopted.
  • Teams that want to reduce administrative overhead and automate invoicing.

Use cases

  • B2B customers: send UBL invoices automatically to corporate clients.
  • Public-sector sales: meet invoicing requirements for government contracts.
  • Custom integrations: connect through the API to your ERP or back-office system.

Sign up

Get started for free via SendPol. No credit card required.
